NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 13, 9:50 PM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 24.6 DraftKings points for $8,700, against Chicago. Kenneth Walker III (24.6, $8,500) and Kyren Williams (23.9, $6,800) are next.

Kyren Williams returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.51 projected points per $1,000 at $6,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 13, 9:50 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 6

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs CHI ($8,700)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 24.6 DraftKings points at $8,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.0 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 17.2 carries and 5.1 targets. The salary works out to 2.82 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 18 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 24.6 points with a simulated floor of 12.5 and a ceiling of 41.2, and he holds 20% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs LAC ($8,500)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 24.6 DraftKings points at $8,500, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 20.1 carries and 4.2 targets. The salary works out to 2.89 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 18 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 24.5 points with a simulated floor of 12.7 and a ceiling of 41.0, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is an 8.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Kyren Williams, LAR vs ARI ($6,800)

Kyren Williams projects 3rd at the position with 23.9 DraftKings points at $6,800, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.6 carries and 4.3 targets. The salary works out to 3.51 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 18 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 23.7 points with a simulated floor of 12.0 and a ceiling of 39.7, and he holds 51% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Rhamondre Stevenson, NE vs NYJ ($6,000)

Rhamondre Stevenson projects for 19.7 DraftKings points at $6,000, which works out to 3.29 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 18 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 18.1 carries and 4.0 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Stevenson averaged 19.6 points with a simulated floor of 9.9 and a ceiling of 33.6, and he holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New England is a 7.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.
